mission.title: Mara
mission.description: Follow Danielle Wright's override trail in search of the biological interface program.

npc.say: Uhh... This is not going to look good when the cops get here.
The Oracle lived in many places. To wander is the lot of the exile.

phase.briefing:
Operative, we've received a few reports of override activity in the slums. This probably indicates the presence of Danielle Wright, and we believe she is still pursuing the biological interface program; we've even heard that she met with the Machines to discuss details of the program. The woman has clearly made herself an enemy, and we must do what we can to prevent her--or the Machines or the Merovingian, for that matter--from capturing the program. It still isn't clear what exactly the program does, but Wright seems to have some idea that it will give her power over the Matrix.
I'm punching up the site of the most recent override activity for you now.

enter.say:
I guess the program's been turning up in all kinds of places; I hear it even got itself into the Hel Club, and when Wright followed it there, she gave the Mervs quite a party over the thing.
Anyway... Ah, the familiar scan glitching that indicates override codes. Looks like a hefty one this time, too.

talk.say: Dang it! I just got this thing. How does a new digital watch run slow?

done.say:
Great, one of those things. Well, unless there's something else, we should--
Uh-oh, more override activity. Watch out!
Okay, let's see if Tyndall has an update on the Wright situation.

phase.briefing:
{player}, our contacts in EPN have informed us that their expeditionary force has been attacked by advanced fighter craft in the Machine no-fly zone. They said that the Kid's hovercraft was able to damage one of the ships, but was itself shot down; the Kid has survived, with some injuries. EPN losses were significant, and they have had to retreat from the zone. There was no indication of the identity of the attackers, but it sounds as though the ships were similar to the advanced craft used by Halborn and Carlyne.
We're now picking up more override reports from central Richland. Wright may be zeroing in on the area. I'm sending you to a new hotspot.

enter.say: Hm, bummer about the Kid. Sounds like he ticked off the Oligarchs somehow, huh?
Got some override activity in there... Don't see a big one this time, fortunately.

done.say: Hm, I'm picking up unknown redpill signals approaching your position. But we got no Wright or interface program there, so there's no reason to stick around.

phase.briefing:
I see... If the Machines and Merovingian are sending their operatives to the area as well, locating the program is going to be much more difficult. I'll alert Command to the problem.
The override front has moved into the Achan/Magog region. There have been a few scattered reports of Wright being spotted in the area, but those remain unconfirmed.

enter.say: Hm... I'm getting some kind of activity reading, but it doesn't look like overrides this time.

talk.say:
What you and these others seek can be found in an apartment once used by the Oracle.
Your operator will find that he has the necessary information. You will excuse me if I do not accompany you there myself. There are other matters I must see to.

done.say:
Seraph? Man, with all the overrides around, I'd think he'd--
Hey, I'm getting some kind of data feed here... Coordinates? Uh, you'd better see about this.

phase.briefing:
This isn't the first time Seraph has stepped in where the interface program was concerned. The Oracle's supposed authorship of the program is the obvious connection, but what could his goal for the program be?
You'd better check those coordinates he fed us, {player}. With all the hostile activity in the area, we don't have much time left to operate there.

enter.say: Seems like we keep getting into these situations in Mara. I kind of thought that would stop after the Oracle was killed, but hey, I guess old habits die hard.

done.say: Hey... It's sort of like that other message we found when we were on the program's tail a week ago. "This isn't," and now "not here." Hmm...

mission.finish:
Another cryptic computer message... If this is the program, it's being very obtuse, although perhaps we're fortunate that it chooses--or is able--to communicate with us at all.
All right, {player}, I think you had better stay out of Mara for the time being. Although we didn't find Wright, we're still getting indications of large-scale hostile activity nearby.
